correctness.rationale: The no-empty-bundle lemma restricts EFX occupancy to precisely T or D; explicit common-value inequalities reduce EFX to an ordered bottom-four threshold and three pairings. Rational finite checking verifies 46,964 assignment cases; only the analytic proof establishes every n.

value.rationale: This is the first nontrivial two-extra-good case after the newly studied one-extra-good online EFX probability. It identifies a natural exact minimax value for positive identical utilities, an optimal ex-ante fair online lottery, and two incompatible value regimes proving sharpness. The reliability scales as 8/n^4, rather than the order n^-2 one-extra-good subclass, quantifying the cost of one more good. This exact natural invariant and structural saddle point are useful benchmarks even without a general downstream theorem; the n! counting input is acknowledged as prior work.
